title: Overly complicated tech and menus
summary: Reviews in this topic chiefly describe the car’s tech, touchscreen, menus, and icons as unnecessarily complicated and awkward to use, sometimes distracting from straightforward driving tasks.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on overly complex software, touchscreen controls, menu structures, icons, and feature settings that make basic functions hard to find or operate.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews praise the car overall but say the new tech system and some functions are still too complicated for simple everyday use.
